findings.source_quote: “Ramona,” he said, “I want you to stay off the gate.”
findings.suggested_fix: 将“我不许你再爬栅门”改为“拉莫娜，”他说，“我不许你再爬栅门。”
findings.translation_quote: “拉莫娜，”他说，“我不许你再爬栅门。”

findings.source_quote: This time, however, she narrowly escaped falling to the ground.
findings.suggested_fix: 改为“不过这一次，她险些摔到地上。”
findings.translation_quote: 不过这次她差一点就摔到了地上。
